working_well: County budget absorption rate: 77% in FY 2024/25, 82nd percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — higher than the peer_group median of 75%.
needs_attention: Development budget absorption rate: 29% in FY 2024/25, 9th percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — lower than the peer_group median of 57%.
Population age 3+ at school or learning institution: 35.3% in 2019 census, 9th percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — lower than the peer_group median of 43.5%.
what_changed: Super Petrol pump price worsened by 33.36 kes_per_litre as of Announced 14 Aug 2026, effective 15 Aug – 14 Sep 2026 (was 180.67 kes_per_litre, now 214.03 kes_per_litre).
County budget absorption rate improved by 1.83 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 75.17%, now 77%).
Development budget absorption rate worsened by 9.7 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 38.7%, now 29%).
